query: I am working in AI and machine learning research. What are the upcoming calls relevant for me?
response:
As an intelligent research assistant, I have analyzed the upcoming Horizon Europe opportunities in Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML). These topics are primarily addressed under **Cluster 4: Digital, Industry & Space** (Pillar II) and the **European Innovation Council (EIC)**.

Here is a summary of the relevant calls found, followed by crucial cross-cutting opportunities for individual researchers.

### 1. Primary Cluster Calls (Cluster 4: Digital, Industry & Space)

Cluster 4 focuses on key digital technologies, including next-generation computing and AI development. The calls typically fund Research and Innovation Actions (RIA) and Innovation Actions (IA).

| # | Call ID | Title Summary | Action Type | Deadline | Cluster | Budget Focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **HORIZON-EIC-2026-AIC-01** | Accelerating Physical AI: Embodied Intelligence for Robotics (Two-stage Challenge) | EIC Pathfinder Challenge | 26 February 2026 | EIC | EUR 219.0M total |
| 2 | HORIZON-CL4-* | (7 Additional topics found) | RIA/IA/CSA | Varies (2025/2026) | CL4 | Topics typically cover trustworthy AI, industrial data platforms, AI for manufacturing, and quantum computing integration. |

**Example Focus Areas in Cluster 4:**
*   **Trustworthy AI:** Developing reliable, ethical, and explainable AI systems (in line with the AI Act).
*   **AI for Manufacturing:** Integrating ML into advanced industrial processes and robotics.
*   **Cognitive Systems:** Research into advanced human-AI teaming and interaction.
*   **Data and Computing:** Utilizing ML/AI for High-Performance Computing (HPC) and cloud-edge infrastructure.

### 2. Crucial Cross-Cutting Opportunities (Thematic Neutral)

For researchers focusing on fundamental AI/ML excellence or individual mobility, two thematic-neutral funding schemes are highly relevant:

#### A. Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA)
MSCA are open to researchers in **ANY field, including AI/ML**, and focus on mobility, training, and career development.

| Action | Focus | Budget & Duration | Eligibility | Next Deadline (Approx.) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships (PF)** | Individual research projects, researcher mobility | €200-300K for 12-24 months | PhD holders (or 4+ years experience) | September 2025 |
| **MSCA Doctoral Networks (DN)** | PhD training networks across academic and non-academic sectors | €2-4M per network, 48 months | Organizations training Early-Stage Researchers (ESR) | November 2025 |

#### B. European Research Council (ERC) Grants
ERC grants fund *excellent frontier research* in any field and are open to researchers of any nationality, provided the host institution is in an EU Member State or Associated Country. Scientific excellence is the sole criterion.

| Grant Type | Career Stage | Funding Cap (5 years) |
|---|---|---|
| **ERC Starting Grants (StG)** | 2-7 years post-PhD | Up to €1.5 Million |
| **ERC Consolidator Grants (CoG)** | 7-12 years post-PhD | Up to €2 Million |
| **ERC Advanced Grants (AdG)** | Track record of 10+ years | Up to €2.5 Million |

### Next Steps for Applicants

To find the detailed description and exact requirements for the 7 Cluster 4 topics and to check the next MSCA/ERC deadlines, you must consult the official documents:

🎯 **Getting Started with Horizon Europe:**
• Register on [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home)
• Review the [Work Programmes](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/reference-documents;programCode=HORIZON) for Cluster 4 and EIC for detailed scope (the 'scope' section of each call is strictly binding).
• Check eligibility via [How to Participate](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/how-to-participate/1)
• Find partners using [Partner Search](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/how-to-participate/partner-search)
• Browse the [Call Calendar](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/opportunities/calls-calendar)
